ModMetaData.name: Lunch Meal
ModMetaData.author: Onofre
ModMetaData.description: Lunch Meal Tired of your colonists suffering the "ate without table" debuff? Tired of them walking halfway across the map just to sit down? This mod adds the ability to pack prepared meals into portable lunches. Wrap any meal at a stove or campfire. These packed lunches can be consumed anywhere without the need for a table, making them perfect for hunters, miners, and soldiers on the front lines. ━━━━━━ FEATURES ━━━━━━ ► Universal Compatibility: Automatically detects meals from all mods, including Vanilla Cooking Expanded. ► Quality Preservation: Packed meals retain the nutrition, mood effects, and ingredients of the original dish. ━━━━━━ DETAILS ━━━━━━ Eat Anywhere — No table required. Eliminate negative mood thoughts for field workers. Automatic detection — Scans all active meals. No extra cooking skill required. ► github.com/onofrela/Lunch-Meal
